metaDescription: Order custom Russell Athletic tank tops in bulk for your team or event. Quality blanks ready for screen printing and embroidery at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Russell Athletic tank tops bring a classic athletic cut and durable cotton-poly blends that stand up to repeated washing and active use. Whether you are outfitting a summer camp staff, a construction crew, or a promotional giveaway, these tanks accept screen printing and embroidery cleanly. The rib-knit collar and armbands keep their shape, making them a reliable choice for branding that needs to last through the season.
